title: C-style map asset orthographics - expanded set
notes: Concept references, not CAD or completed 3D meshes.
Target dimensions in prompts are design intent; projections require manual scale and correspondence calibration.
One subject per sheet. Humanoid and land-animal views are front/right/back; others front/right/top.
No runtime models or gameplay files are modified.
Keep animated parts separate: wheels, oars, sails, limbs, tails, foliage and water vegetation.
Do not feed the whole sheet as a single object; use supported separate-view inputs or calibrate reference planes in Blender.
All selected images were visually inspected; 12 assets received targeted revisions. This does not establish CAD-level cross-view correspondence.
The selected file is in each asset.file; draftFile is retained for comparison, not an extra asset.
Remaining modeling caveats are recorded per asset where identified; all proportions and occlusions need Blender calibration.

assets.label: 成熟麦田
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE high-quality orthographic modeling reference sheet for ONE asset in a cohesive non-photorealistic low-poly civilization strategy-game art kit. Style matches a faceted green tree, gray mossy rock, off-white timber cottage with terracotta roof, and cream octagonal windmill with blue-gray roof. Large intentional polygon facets, simplified but rich silhouette and structural details, matte flat-shaded materials, restrained surface texture. NOT photorealistic, NOT smooth clay, NOT voxel, NOT anime, NOT crude primitive placeholders. Clean pure white background, neutral soft studio illumination, no cast ground shadows. Exactly THREE views of the SAME asset and SAME geometry, fully visible, evenly spaced across three columns on a wide landscape sheet. No isometric or three-quarter perspective. Keep details, object count, asymmetry, proportions, color placement, orientation and scale consistent across views. Generous outer margins; nothing clipped. No text, labels, logos, dimensions, frames, grid, scene, UI, swatches or extra unrelated objects. Do not include a hex tile, decorative pedestal or floating island.
View order LEFT: FRONT straight-on elevation; CENTER: exact RIGHT SIDE elevation; RIGHT: true TOP PLAN looking vertically down 90 degrees, NOT an angled overhead view. Front and side share ground/water datum and height; top uses front toward bottom of page. Same world-units-per-pixel, not arbitrary resizing to fill each panel. Top correctly hides surfaces occluded by roofs/canopies.
SUBJECT: One modular rectangular wheat field, footprint 4 x 5 m, six straight crop rows with clear narrow soil furrows. Ochre-gold low-poly ears on modest green-gold stalks, 0.8 m crop height, small unevenness within each row but exactly six rows in all views. Exposed neutral umber soil less than 0.12 m thick, edges level and flush for joining adjacent terrain. No raised slab, fences or border. Top plan displays the six crop bands; elevations show stalk structure. Crops may later sway as separate clumps.

Style matches a faceted green tree, gray mossy rock, off-white timber cottage with terracotta roof, and cream octagonal windmill with blue-gray roof. Large intentional polygon facets, simplified but rich silhouette and structural details, matte flat-shaded materials, restrained surface texture. NOT photorealistic, NOT smooth clay, NOT voxel, NOT anime, NOT crude primitive placeholders. Clean pure white background, neutral soft studio illumination, no cast ground shadows. Exactly THREE views of the SAME asset and SAME geometry, fully visible, evenly spaced across three columns on a wide landscape sheet. No isometric or three-quarter perspective. Keep details, object count, asymmetry, proportions, color placement, orientation and scale consistent across views. Generous outer margins; nothing clipped. No text, labels, logos, dimensions, frames, grid, scene, UI, swatches or extra unrelated objects. Do not include a hex tile, decorative pedestal or floating island.
View order LEFT: FRONT straight-on elevation; CENTER: exact RIGHT SIDE elevation; RIGHT: true TOP PLAN looking vertically down 90 degrees, NOT an angled overhead view. Front and side share ground/water datum and height; top uses front toward bottom of page. Same world-units-per-pixel, not arbitrary resizing to fill each panel. Top correctly hides surfaces occluded by roofs/canopies.
SUBJECT: One straight modular wooden pier 6 m long x 2 m wide, level plank deck on six timber pilings arranged three per side, four simple short mooring posts at corners, one gray mooring ring attached to front-right post. Desaturated timber, broad end grain, subtle darker lower pile sections. Front looks down pier from shore end, side shows length and three piles, top shows uninterrupted planks and four posts. Uniform joinable shore edge at deck height; full piles visible, no water, shoreline, boats, people, ropes or ground platform.
assets.revisionPrompt: Correct camera and structural consistency of this exact wooden pier three-view sheet. Preserve palette, faceted wood, iron ring, no water, white background. Geometry is six vertical round piles in TWO rows of THREE (front, middle, back), all six tops protrude the same short distance above deck. LEFT is a strict horizontal-camera front elevation: two near piles obscure farther piles and deck is seen edge-on, not a long top surface. CENTER strict side shows three piles evenly spaced with same above-deck height, not a shorter middle pile. RIGHT true top plan must show SIX round post tops: three on each long side, including the missing two center posts. Entrance/front at bottom. Keep iron ring on front right pile. No text.
